name: Walidad Khan
contribution: Walidad Khan led rebel forces in the Bulandshahr region during the 1857 uprising and briefly challenged Company authority there.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His profile shows how local leaders and district-level power shaped the rebellion beyond its most famous centers.
highlight: Walidad Khan was a regional rebel leader associated with the 1857 uprising in Bulandshahr.
seoTitle: Walidad Khan: Bulandshahr and the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Walidad Khan's regional leadership and the Bulandshahr resistance during the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Walidad Khan was a regional rebel leader who challenged Company authority in the Bulandshahr area during 1857.
